purpose: collision-blind calibration of a direction-neutral grip-off fast channel and mass-aware table gate

upstream_changes.V: unchanged after D3_STATE_PROTOCOL rejected every candidate
upstream_changes.W_main: table explanation additionally requires box_mass > 0; reconstruction/projection unchanged
upstream_changes.fast_channel: before updating an EMA, innovation = raw reconstructed wrench - EMA; EMA alpha=observer_gain*dt=0.05; channel enabled only while grip=0; grip=1 clears its persistence counter
upstream_changes.jacobian_conditioning: unchanged solve/lstsq fallback; D1 observed condition <=8, so no unsupported regularization is added

prohibited_selection_inputs: collision time, direction, force, or delay
configured JTS offset, drift, or seed

sampling.mass_kg: training includes 0 and 8 plus continuous uniform [0,8]

features.symmetry: Fx=Fy and Mx=My in both channels

selection.base: maximum training sliding-window minimum amplitude per group
selection.threshold: 1.25*base + unit margin; then shared feature-switch scale max(1,1.25*q)
selection.joint_cost: main channel cost + fast channel cost
selection.selection_rule: minimum joint cost; exact tie lower main persistence then lower fast persistence

validation.cold_collection: both alarms forced false so provisional thresholds cannot alter bias freeze
validation.training_replay: normal combined alarm; up to two training-only 10% score-derived inflation passes
validation.holdout: one validation pass only; never fit
validation.collision_testing: forbidden until protocol, selected parameters, training, holdout, and production SHA are leader-reviewed and frozen
